mapSource: Geofabrik OpenStreetMap extract for Georgia country
notes: The binary map is generated by GitHub Actions from the Geofabrik Georgia country PBF, checked by MD5, written with Mapsforge Map Writer type=hd, then packaged inside the APK. The source ZIP does not contain the generated binary. Name variants are included only where available in OSM; no automatic translation is performed. The app currently displays one preferred language at a time.
languageCoverage: Only OSM name variants present in source data are written; no automatic translation.
mapBuildPipeline: GitHub Actions: Geofabrik OSM PBF -> Mapsforge Map Writer -> APK assets
